board.text: Blue Anchor (1722, Hammersmith Bridge) pairs with The Dove (#22): station → bridge → riverside walk → Dove. The West errand, solved.
Alternates: Holly Bush on the Heath day (can swap for the Spaniards); Plume of Feathers (1691) on the Greenwich day, 5 min from Trafalgar Tavern.
Churchill Arms (#21) pairing: the tick plus Sunday roast at the Fat Badger or pie at the Pelican, all within a 10-min Notting Hill walk.
Old Bank of England (Fleet St, 1888 banking hall) is a pending candidate — Patrick's call. Slots by the Cheshire Cheese.
City cluster is a weekday play: Butler's Head, the Jampot, the Mitre and Cittie of Yorke all shut or limited at weekends.
Before any crawl, ask in the thread — big football nights pack every pub in zones 1–2.
